# netcup_reverse_dns (Resource)

Reverse DNS (PTR) entry for an IPv4 or IPv6 address of a netcup server, managed via the SCP REST API. The IP must already belong to one of your servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reverse DNS (PTR) for a server IP. Needs scp_refresh_token on the provider.
resource "netcup_reverse_dns" "mail_v4" {
  ip       = "203.0.113.10"
  hostname = "mail.example.com"
}

resource "netcup_reverse_dns" "mail_v6" {
  ip       = "2a03:4000:47:584::1"
  hostname = "mail.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) PTR target hostname, e.g. `mail.example.com`.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address to set the PTR for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Equals the IP address.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: the IP address itself
terraform import netcup_reverse_dns.mail_v4 203.0.113.10
```
